name: big-project-constructor
description: Project memory for non-technical builders. Use when someone is starting a big project (a business, book, podcast, renovation, job search, app), wants to pick up where a previous conversation left off, keeps losing track of what was decided, or says 'wrap it up' or 'end session'. Sets up a project folder, a per-topic running log and current-state summary, and an end-of-session ritual that saves everything for next time.
